folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B379: preserved mechanisms and dated verification limits
folds.body:
All127 table rows, eleven nuance paragraphs and ranked gaps were read. Preserve the mechanisms behind the requests: chosen repeat is not entrapment or duplicate processing; reciprocal return needs actual means and a scoped paused life; preparation, useful later reuse and available helpers have real costs; a supervised initiation is not immune to source-causal hazards; an estimate can be wrong and must remain marked; identical opponent labels do not erase instance identity. Free mixing/depth choice, type-fitting cheat surfaces, layered repair, better smiths and player-hosted gatherings remain useful palettes with actual source/actor/consumer questions, rather than a required universal implementation.

Existence-level BUILT labels, source-test filenames, stale line numbers and grep misses are dated leads, not technical floor. Later structural/visual receipts can qualify an older unverified item only for their actual input/state. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md), AD42/44/51/52 and UI rules govern sequencing: optional taste review is not a missing technical gate; developer lead-first retains other lives; useful shared seams need no universal interpreter; compressed activity retains consequential means, knowledge and clocks. Legacy1366 targets, old R14 parity baseline, no-new-NPC assumptions and menu/mastery proposals do not override later direction.

A missing story continuation beyond built content is an authoring edge, not an impossible or forbidden character action. Preserve the old warning/park proposal without claiming a runtime that was not exercised. Dropping unknown IDs, retaining dormant/retired bytes and refusing an unsupported executable schema are different compatibility outcomes; old-save deferral does not waive new-state round trips, require data deletion or authorize private-save access. No bought map, universal rune system, exact hidden-market canon, full crowd behavior or source hazard was newly verified by this read.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B379: current rule adoption and preserved open possibilities
folds.body:
All148 rows, the status census, ten subtle-aspect paragraphs and eight ranked gaps were read. Two concrete authority findings are stale against current owners: row13's unrecorded background-only rule is explicit in [AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md); row108's WA32–WA35 awaiting-yes qualifier is settled by [WA25–WA41 adoption](../../WORLD_ABSORPTION_RULES.md), with WA42–WA47 still proposals. An adopted adjustable rule does not itself prove runtime implementation. Current AD51 explicitly owns shared seams, qualifying row121's missing-AD observation; AD52 supplies later activity/clock/long-play defaults without adopting every example.

Preserve substantive unmet possibilities rather than broad completion labels: gear chemistry/energy/lifetimes differ from ordinary parts and affixes; process/material substitution depends on actual source traits and quantities, not a unit-label conversion; roofs, nonhuman homes, unfinished work, staff rest/wages/custody and actual residence-aware labor keep their own consequences. Learned title/skill/power, observer meaning, semantic UI and authored lore are not interchangeable. The old all53 palette claim, code/test presence and original integration/adoption receipt cannot establish every later variant or today's installed build. Source reading, whole-source qualification, gameplay merge and a complete book replay are separate, with dated denominators rather than a current whole-campaign percentage.

Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md) retains LOTM-first/HP-alongside, mechanisms with their display consumers, ordinary low-spoiler starts later, Frontier/Mistglass as test beds and local-AI bulk drafting later. Lead canon policy is local to that mode, not a ban on emergent ordinary lives; source windows need no invented hour precision. Absence clocks, independent world events, frozen lives and unused-time banks cannot promise production or reach-out without an actual supported mechanism. A forced short campaign, new picture/animation quota, universal archetype/stock registry or full all-world wave does not follow from the audit rankings.

Human review stays optional under AD42; old player gates, proposed defaults, costs, reader ceilings/reset dates, active-worker names, package hashes and publication instructions keep their historical scopes. No runtime/source census, actual rendered font, source-canon hazard, acquisition, app adoption, purchase or remote push was newly verified or authorized here. Useful questions about fate/pull, injury consumers, conceptual powers, ordinary entry and full-journey coverage remain with their incumbent owners.
